query: Our onboarding flow animations feel stiff and mechanical. The slide-in transitions use a 300ms linear ease.
expected_behavior: Chooses motion based on whether the onboarding transition involves direct manipulation or a discrete state change
Allows a spring when justified, while allowing a suitable easing curve, platform transition, or no motion for discrete transitions
Preserves clear progress and feedback with reduced motion enabled
Keeps the change scoped to the reported animation issue
